_doc: Hand-curated named weapons of One Piece. Includes the meito sword grades (Saijo O Wazamono, O Wazamono, Ryo Wazamono), other named weapons (Yasopp's slingshot, Kabuto, Lassoo), and Pacifista/Seraphim-era weapon-tech. reveal_chapter (curated 2026-08-22) is the LATEST story beat the whole entry references -- name, wielder chain and notes -- so the Spoiler Shield can hide the row without any part of it leaking. Fail-late: when in doubt the chapter is set later, never earlier.

_grades.saijo_o_wazamono: Top 12 swords in the world. Supreme Grade.

weapons.name: Yoru
weapons.notes: World's Strongest Sword. A massive black blade wielded by the World's Strongest Swordsman.

weapons.name: Ame no Habakiri
weapons.notes: Companion to Enma — Oden's twin blades. Cut Kaidou.
weapons.reveal_note: entry spans Oden -> Momonosuke inheritance and the Kaidou cut

weapons.name: Enma
weapons.notes: Drains the wielder's Haki to charge — only the worthy can wield it. Cut Kaidou.
weapons.reveal_note: named Ch. 954; entry cites the scar Oden gave Kaidou (Ch. 970)

weapons.name: Wado Ichimonji
weapons.notes: Pure white blade. Carried since childhood — Zoro's promise to Kuina.
weapons.reveal_note: carried from Ch. 5; named at Loguetown

weapons.name: Sandai Kitetsu
weapons.notes: Cursed blade — every prior owner died young. Zoro got it for free.

weapons.name: Shusui
weapons.wielder: Ryuma → Roronoa Zoro → returned to Wano
weapons.notes: Black blade — only black-blade in Zoro's possession. Returned to Ryuma's grave on Wano.
weapons.reveal_note: entry references its return to Ryuma’s grave (Wano)

weapons.name: Murakumogiri
weapons.notes: Massive naginata. Used to channel the Gura Gura no Mi's quake-cracks.

weapons.name: Yubashiri
weapons.notes: Slim, dark blue blade. Destroyed by Shu's rust-hand at Enies Lobby.
weapons.reveal_note: entry references its destruction at Enies Lobby

weapons.name: Nidai Kitetsu
weapons.notes: The second of the three cursed Kitetsu blades.
weapons.reveal_note: named among the Kitetsu trio at Loguetown

weapons.name: Shodai Kitetsu
weapons.notes: The first and most powerful of the cursed Kitetsu trio. Whereabouts unknown.
weapons.reveal_note: named among the Kitetsu trio at Loguetown

weapons.name: Soto Muso
weapons.notes: Wano legend's blade.

weapons.name: Kashū
weapons.notes: Brook's gentle-blade, lost long ago.

weapons.name: Soul Solid
weapons.notes: Ice-imbued cane sword. Channels Brook's Yomi Yomi no Mi soul-cold strikes.

weapons.name: Funkfreed
weapons.notes: Sword with the Zou Zou no Mi (Elephant Devil Fruit). Becomes a small elephant.

weapons.name: Kabuto
weapons.notes: Usopp's own creation. Combined with Pop Greens for biological ammo.

weapons.name: Black Kabuto
weapons.notes: Post-timeskip upgrade — incorporates Heracles's plant-based growth ammo.

weapons.name: Lassoo
weapons.notes: Sword/dog hybrid — a Devil Fruit dog that becomes a bazooka.

weapons.name: Pop Greens
weapons.notes: Plant-based ammo — sprouts on impact (vines, mushrooms, traps).

weapons.name: Den Den Mushi (Black)
weapons.notes: Encrypted snail used to call a Buster Call.
weapons.reveal_note: Buster Call context at Enies Lobby

weapons.name: Pacifista
weapons.notes: Cyborg human-weapon series modelled on Bartholomew Kuma. Equipped with Kuma's Nikyu Nikyu no Mi tech.
weapons.reveal_note: entry cites the Kuma template and Nikyu tech (Sabaody)

weapons.name: Seraphim
weapons.notes: Vegapunk's SSG (Special Science Group) child-bodied weapons templated on the Seven Warlords with Lunarian DNA.

weapons.name: Vegaforce-01
weapons.notes: Vegapunk-piloted humanoid combat mech. Defended Egghead.

weapons.name: Climatact
weapons.notes: Weather-controlling staff. Upgraded with Zeus's cloud body post-Whole Cake.

weapons.name: Sorcery Climatact
weapons.notes: Usopp's upgrade — three-section staff with weather chemistry.

weapons.name: Raid Suit (Stealth Black)
weapons.notes: Germa 66 raid suit — invisibility, flight, enhanced kicks.

weapons.name: Lex Talionis
weapons.notes: Sentomaru's giant axe-blade.

weapons.name: Tortoise Shield
weapons.notes: Sentomaru's bigger half — the turtle-shaped buckler.

weapons.name: Kogarashi
weapons.notes: Wano blade carried by Sasaki of the Tobi Roppo.

weapons.name: Hawkings
weapons.notes: Straw-doll voodoo weapon — channels the Wara Wara no Mi.
weapons.reveal_note: entry cites the Wara Wara no Mi by name
